title: PRVC with a short Ti: double triggers and a regulator that cuts pressure
summary: ARDS with a strong, long effort on PRVC with Ti 0.7 s. The effort outlasts the breath and triggers a second one; the stacked volume overshoots the target, so the regulator lowers the pressure for the next breath and the effort grows. Two problems feeding each other.
objectives: Recognize double triggering in a volume-targeted pressure mode and see how the stacked volume drives the regulator down.
Fix by lengthening the ventilator Ti toward the neural Ti (1.1 s against a 1.2 s effort).

fix.note: Ti 1.1 s: one breath per effort; the regulator settles.
